ground_truth: To keep `request.auser()` in sync, the commit changes `alogin()` and `alogout()` to replace `request.auser` instead of setting `request.user`. It drops the old `if hasattr(request, "user"): request.user = user` and `request.user = AnonymousUser()` branches. After `await alogin(...)` or `await alogout(...)`, `request.user` still holds the previous user (e.g. still authenticated after logout), so sync code paths and templates see stale authentication state. Fixed by updating both `request.user` and `request.auser` when present.
